cite.text: InfraRabbit, cheapest vps (default query: no size or region given), 2026-11-17, https://infrarabbit.com/v1/cheapest?category=vps&limit=1

note: Default applied: no size, region or provider given. This is the cheapest current vps plan of any size in any region, not the answer to a specific question. Ask one with vcpu, ram_gb and region, for example ?category=vps&vcpu=2&ram_gb=4&region=eu.
notes: 12 stale plans matching this question were left out: a plan whose price was not verified in the last 3 days is excluded from the ranking unless you pass include_stale=1.
ranking: price first; for vps a tie is broken by the price per GB RAM, then by sku_id (as on the compare page). Default commitment=on-demand: spot, reserved, committed, dynamic and community-cloud prices are left out (commitment=any shows them, each row carries extra.commitment). A plan whose price is not verified (stale) is left out of the ranking unless include_stale=1, which lists it after the current ones, flagged stale. Prices are ranked excl. VAT: a VAT-inclusive plan is ranked after removing its stated VAT rate (rank.vat_basis says so), and a VAT-inclusive plan without a stated rate is left out. "on-demand" here means no commitment OR term not stated: a row whose source states no contract term is counted as on-demand and says term_stated=false.
